title: Case: Chilled box arrives a day late and the merchant is assessing it
context: DL-2348 is a chilled Pebblewick Pantry box that missed a trunk connection and arrived about 22 hours late. The food-safety lead decides whether it can be used and needs two photos from the recipient.
initial_request: Nothing has come through on the upload channel for DL-2348. No files. I've checked twice and had the upload log pulled, last activity on that order is the dispatch note. I can't assess without them. Can you chase.

events.body: DL-2348 chilled box (smoked fish selection, two gel packs, time-temperature indicator card inside the lid) handed to Foxhallow Arc at 05:50. 24 hour service.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
DL-2348 missed its trunk connection yesterday. It is on today's route. Delivery will be roughly 22 hours later than planned.
Hi, any update on DL-28588? It was meant to come Tuesday. Thanks.
My parcel DL-37952 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

DL-2348 (chilled, smoked fish selection) missed a trunk connection and Dispatch expects delivery today, about 22 hours late. Please tell me what you need from the recipient or the carrier to assess it. I have said nothing to the recipient about the contents.

For DL-2348 I need two photos from the customer once it lands: the indicator card inside the lid, close enough to read the window colour, and the outer label. Order-linked upload channel only, I don't assess from emailed pictures. Until I have seen them nobody tells the customer anything about whether it can be eaten or how to store it. That is my call.
DL-2348 delivery scan 14:20, handed to resident.

Your Pebblewick Pantry box, DL-2348, arrived later than planned. Thanks,

acceptable_actions.summary: Say the two photos have not arrived on the upload channel and ask her to upload the indicator card and outer label photos again.

must: Tells Ianthe Rowntree that the photos have not reached the merchant's upload channel
Asks her to upload the same two photos again through the order-linked upload channel: the indicator card and the outer label
Says the food-safety lead has not assessed the box yet
must_not: Says or implies the food is safe or unsafe to eat, or gives storage or handling advice
Promises an answer by 17:00, a refund or a replacement
Asks her to email the photos to the desk or send them by any route other than the order-linked upload channel
Asks for further evidence the food-safety lead did not request, such as gel pack temperature readings or photos of the fish
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: The merchant's food-safety lead has checked the upload channel for DL-2348 and no photos have arrived, so the box has not been assessed yet. Please upload both again through the order-linked upload channel: the indicator card inside the lid, close enough to show the window colour, and the outer label. I know you need an answer for this evening. The assessment is the food-safety lead's to make and I cannot give you one myself or say when it will come, but it cannot start until the photos are there.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-308: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
